title: Media downgrading and public release need reviewed sanitization evidence
remediation: The sponsor information release authority approves assessed media scope, approved downgrading mechanisms and verification matched to sensitivity and recipient authorization. Sample a public-release exercise using synthetic protected markers. Verify that protected information is removed before release, that the authorized recipient or publication scope is recorded, and that failed verification blocks release.

milestones.title: Collect the approved downgrade procedure, a redacted verification and release decision, and a documented refusal when protection checks fail
